query: New York State Prohibited Plants List
information:
*New York State Prohibited Plants List* (from DEC PDF “isprohibitedplants2.pdf”)

**Terrestrial Plants**  
- Amur Cork Tree (Phellodendron amurense)  
- Amur Honeysuckle (Lonicera maackii)  
- Autumn Olive (Elaeagnus umbellata)  
- Beach Vitex (Vitex rotundifolia)  
- Black Swallow‑wort (Cynanchum louiseae)  
- Bohemian Knotweed (Reynoutria x bohemica) – also listed as (Fallopia x bohemica, Polygonum x bohemica)  
- Border Privet (Ligustrum obtusifolium)  
- Broad‑leaved Pepper‑grass (Lepidium latifolium) – also includes (C. setosum, C. incanum, Serratula arvensis)  
- Chinese Lespedeza (Lespedeza cuneata)  
- Chinese Yam (Dioscorea polystachya) – also Dioscorea batatas  
- Cogon Grass (Imperata cylindrica) – also I. arundinacea, Lagurus cylindricus  
- Common Buckthorn (Rhamnus cathartica)  
- Cup‑plant (Silphium perfoliatum)  
- Cut‑leaf Teasel (Dipsacus laciniatus)  
- Cypress Spurge (Euphorbia cyparissias)  
- Fly Honeysuckle (Lonicera x bella)  
- Garden Loosestrife (Lysimachia vulgaris)  
- Garlic Mustard (Alliaria petiolata)  
- Giant Hogweed (Heracleum mantegazzianum)  
- Giant Knotweed (Reynoutria sachalinensis) – also Fallopia sachalinensis, Polygonum sachalinensis  
- Golden Bamboo (Phyllostachys aurea) – also Phyllostachys aureosulcata  
- Gray Florist’s Willow (Salix atrocinerea)  
- Japanese Angelica Tree (Aralia elata)  
- Japanese Barberry (Berberis thunbergii)  
- Japanese Chaff Flower (Achyranthes japonica)  
- Japanese Honeysuckle (Lonicera japonica)  
- Japanese Hops (Humulus japonicus)  
- Japanese Knotweed (Reynoutria japonica) – also Fallopia japonica, Polygonum cuspidatum  
- Japanese Stilt Grass (Microstegium vimineum) – also Fallopia japonica, Polygonum cuspidatum  
- Kudzu (Pueraria montana)  
- Leafy Spurge (Euphorbia esula)  
- Lesser Celandine (Ficaria verna) – also (Ranunculus fcaria)  
- Mile‑a‑Minute Weed (Persicaria perfoliata) – also Polygonum perfoliatum  
- Multifora Rose (Rosa multifora)  
- Pale Swallow‑wort (Cynanchum rossicum) – also (C. medium, Vincetoxicum medium, V. rossicum)  
- Porcelain Berry (Ampelopsis brevipedunculata)  
- Small Carpetgrass (Arthraxon hispidus)  
- Spotted Knapweed (Centaurea stoebe) – also (C. biebersteinii, C. diffusa, C. maculosa misapplied, C. xpsammogena)  
- Tartarian Honeysuckle (Lonicera tatarica)  
- Wineberry (Rubus phoenicolasius)

**Wetland Plants**  
- Common Reed Grass (Phragmites australis)  
- Marsh Dewfower (Murdannia keisak)  
- Purple Loosestrife (Lythrum salicaria)  
- Reed Manna Grass (Glyceria maxima)  
- Smooth Buckthorn (Frangula alnus) – also Rhamnus frangula  
- Yellow Iris (Iris pseudacorus)

**Aquatic Plants**  
- Brazilian Waterweed (Egeria densa)  
- Broadleaf Water‑milfoil Hybrid (Myriophyllum heterophyllum × M. laxum)  
- Curly Pondweed (Potamogeton crispus)  
- Eurasian Water‑milfoil (Myriophyllum spicatum)  
- Fanwort (Cabomba caroliniana)  
- Floating Primrose Willow (Ludwigia peploides)  
- Frogbit (Hydrocharis morsus‑ranae)  
- Hydrilla/Water Thyme (Hydrilla verticillata)  
- Parrot‑feather (Myriophyllum aquaticum)  
- Uruguayan Primrose Willow (Ludwigia hexapetala) – also (L. grandifora)  
- Water Chestnut (Trapa natans)  
- Yellow Floating Heart (Nymphoides peltata)

 – the list above compiles all plant entries noted under the “PROHIBITED” sections of the DEC PDF. The PDF may contain additional formatting or synonyms not captured here; further verification against the source PDF is recommended.
